# Product Overview

**Status:** replacement overview.

Cite2Site lets people cite evidence without marking up the source. It stores
every intentional citation in a dedicated authority repository and derives
status, exports, and publication output from replay.

The replacement protocol adds stable groups, group-owned handles, scoped
duplicate policy, complete rolling tallies, and deterministic reconciliation.
This is a clean replacement, not a migration from the archived v0.3/v1 model.
